## How to test


## Checklist

- [ ] `make lint` passes (pylint >= 9.5)
- [ ] `make test` passes, new code has tests
- [ ] Docstrings on new public functions/classes
- [ ] README / docs updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, no `.env`, no big data files committed
